what_this_is: Per-trial outcomes for every evaluated cell of the static-grip-retention screen and its preflight reference. Sufficient to recompute every completion rate, paired comparison and pace figure in the accompanying report.
verdict: No eligible recipe. aux_anchor reached +1.875 pp mean low-friction gain against a required >= 2 pp. Criteria were fixed before the final screen selection and before the outcomes were inspected; the threshold was not changed. For every recipe the two training seeds disagree in sign at low friction, so these runs give insufficient evidence of a robust method-level benefit.

protocol.friction: static per episode: mu is set per cell and constant for the whole episode

gates.kind: engineering eligibility gates; not a significance or power analysis
gates.timing: fixed before the final screen selection and before outcome inspection
gates.pace: one-sided: at most 3 % WORSE (slower) on commonly completed trials; faster is not capped

preflight.note: The full per-step traces are NOT in this repository: they are 0.62 GiB. Every number in the report is recomputable from the per-trial outcomes published here; the trace file is needed only to re-derive the per-step controller diagnostics.

screen.note: The full per-step traces are NOT in this repository: they are 1.24 GiB. Every number in the report is recomputable from the per-trial outcomes published here; the trace file is needed only to re-derive the per-step controller diagnostics.

note: Engineering eligibility only. No statistical significance claim. On-car performance is not established by any number here.

primary_table.per_checkpoint: 5 maps x 3 mu x 2 eval seeds = 30 cells, x 8 envs = 240 trials

not_in_the_recipe_decision.note: earlier estimated-arm policies, published for reference only

cell_accounting.fingerprint_audit_scope: 360 cell records = 12 system records (8 screen + 4 preflight) x 30 scenarios. This is a count of audited start records across both stages, not the 270-cell primary table.
